limitations: Diagnostic EXPLAIN ANALYZE executions establish their own access paths; they are not traces from the earlier end-to-end benchmark windows.
EXPLAIN wrappers report they are not eligible for prepared plan caching; timed SELECT cache observations are recorded separately.
Warm small samples have outliers and no statistical confidence interval. Reduced scanned keys do not establish fewer physical SSD IOPS or better concurrent Drive throughput.

Name index remains nonunique and complete binary-name equality is retained; tested wellformed SQL hits/misses do not replace provider corruption, duplicate-cardinality, cross-volume, cancellation, or write transaction qualification.

RustFS actual memory limit was 2GiB during these metadata-only runs versus 1GiB recorded in retained ready receipt; RustFS was unused. TiDB/TiKV/PD identities and resource limits were pinned unchanged.
scope: isolated metadata-only prepared SQL; two fresh volumes with 100/1000 empty regular files; one warmed connection per run; no RustFS traffic or logical Drive IOPS/capacity/durability/allocation claims
timing: 30 alternating pairs per variant after four warm pairs; exec including network/server/row decode; excludes preparation, parameter cloning, immediate cache-flag observation, row witnesses and artifact writes
